parameters.query:
-- Buscar dados para dashboard do Telegram
WITH dados_sistema AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clientes WHERE status = 'ativo') as clientes_ativos,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interacoes WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE) as mensagens_hoje,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interacoes WHERE requer_hitl = true AND status_hitl = 'pendente') as hitl_pendentes,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visitas WHERE DATE(data_hora) = CURRENT_DATE AND status IN ('agendada', 'confirmada')) as visitas_hoje,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM imoveis WHERE status = 'disponivel') as imoveis_disponiveis
)
SELECT * FROM dados_sistema;

-- Buscar clientes ativos recentes
SELECT 
  c.id,
  c.nome,
  c.telefone,
  c.tipo_interesse,
  c.score_qualificacao,
  c.ultima_interacao,
  EXTRACT(DAYS FROM NOW() - c.ultima_interacao) as dias_sem_contato
FROM clientes c
WHERE c.status = 'ativo'
ORDER BY c.ultima_interacao DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- Buscar visitas do dia
SELECT 
  v.id,
  v.data_hora,
  v.status,
  c.nome as cliente_nome,
  c.telefone as cliente_telefone,
  i.codigo_interno as imovel_codigo,
  i.endereco as imovel_endereco,
  u.nome as corretor_nome
FROM visitas v
JOIN clientes c ON v.cliente_id = c.id
JOIN imoveis i ON v.imovel_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN usuarios_sistema u ON v.corretor_id = u.id
WHERE DATE(v.data_hora) = CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY v.data_hora ASC;

-- Buscar solicitações HITL pendentes
SELECT 
  i.id,
  i.created_at,
  i.canal,
  i.mensagem,
  i.prioridade,
  c.nome as cliente_nome,
  c.telefone as cliente_telefone
FROM interacoes i
JOIN clientes c ON i.cliente_id = c.id
WHERE i.requer_hitl = true 
  AND i.status_hitl = 'pendente'
ORDER BY i.prioridade DESC, i.created_at ASC
LIMIT 10;
